name: User Registration for Elementor Forms
author: add-ons.org

sections.description:
Demo: https://demo.add-ons.org/demo-user-registration/
Document: https://add-ons.org/document-user-registration-for-elementor-forms/
Pro Version: https://add-ons.org/plugin/user-registration-for-elementor-forms/

User Registration for Elementor Forms adds a simple but powerful user registration feature to Elementor Pro Forms.
Easily build custom registration forms, map form fields to WordPress user profile data, and automatically assign roles to new users.
The plugin also supports advanced validation rules to ensure secure and reliable registrations (e.g., prevent duplicate emails or restrict email domains).

Features

  • User Registration Form: Create user registration forms with Elementor Pro Forms.
  • User activation: Enable and verify new user accounts to ensure only authorized users can access the system.
  • Password Reset: Add forgot password and reset functionality.
  • Field Mapping: Map Elementor form fields to WordPress user profile fields (username, email, first name, last name, etc.).
  • Role Assignment: Automatically assign roles to newly registered users.
  • Custom Validation: Validate user data (e.g., prevent duplicate emails, restrict email domains).
  • Security Ready: Supports WordPress nonces, reCAPTCHA, and honeypot protection.
  • Seamless Elementor Integration: Works natively with Elementor Pro Forms, no extra setup needed.
  • Translation Ready: Fully translatable and WPML compatible.
  • Custom Validation: Add extra validation such as checking for existing emails, validating usernames, or restricting email domains.

Pro Features

  • Custom User Meta: Map extra Elementor fields (phone, company, address, etc.) to WordPress user meta fields.
  • Conditional Logic: Add smart logic to your forms. Show/hide fields or change registration behavior based on conditions (e.g. checkbox, dropdown, role assignment).
sections.installation:
Normal installation

  1. Download the xxxx.zip file to your computer.
  2. Unzip the file.
  3. Upload the xxxx directory to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  4. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
